chat.empty: No messages yet. Send a prompt to begin.
chat.placeholder: Ask OpenCode anything…  (Enter = send, Shift+Enter = new line)
chat.title: OpenCode Chat

chooser.empty: No sessions yet. Create one to get started.
chooser.title: OpenCode — Sessions

error.connection_failed_detail: The server did not respond to a health check.
error.exe_not_found_detail: Install opencode and ensure it is available on your PATH.
error.server_timeout: Server did not start in time
error.server_timeout_detail: The server did not become healthy within the timeout period.
error.session_error_detail: The agent stopped due to an error.

notify.permission_body: OpenCode is waiting for your approval.
notify.title: OpenCode

permission.default_message: OpenCode wants to perform an action that requires your approval.
permission.title: Permission Required

auto_start.description: Automatically start the managed server when the plugin loads.
auto_start.label: Auto-start Server

debug_logging.description: Print debug messages to the Noctalia log.
debug_logging.label: Debug Logging

default_agent.description: Default agent to use for new sessions. Default: 'build'.
default_agent.label: Default Agent

default_model.description: Default model in 'provider/model' format (e.g., 'anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022'). Leave empty to use server default.
default_model.label: Default Model

default_workspace.description: Default working directory for new sessions. Leave empty to use the current directory.
default_workspace.label: Default Workspace

language.description: Language for this plugin's UI. 'Auto' follows the Noctalia shell language.
language.label: Language

max_messages_load.description: Messages loaded per session (1–100). Set the slider to its top notch for unlimited. Default: 50.
max_messages_load.label: Max Messages to Load

panel_mode.description: Fill right opens a full-height panel pinned to the right edge; Compact shows the original floating panel near the bar click.
panel_mode.label: Panel Layout

server_host.description: Hostname the managed server binds to. Default: 127.0.0.1 (loopback only).
server_host.label: Server Host

server_mode.description: How the plugin connects to OpenCode. 'auto' manages a local server; 'external' connects to a user-specified URL.
server_mode.label: Server Mode

server_port.description: Port the managed server listens on. Default: 4096.
server_port.label: Server Port

server_url.description: Base URL of an external OpenCode server (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:4096). Used when Server Mode is 'external'.
server_url.label: External Server URL

show_reasoning.description: Display reasoning/thinking text in the chat view.
show_reasoning.label: Show Reasoning

show_tool_calls.description: Display tool call status cards in the chat view.
show_tool_calls.label: Show Tool Calls

ui_mode.description: Full shows a spacious layout; Compact tightens padding, fonts and hides secondary details to keep the panel minimal.
ui_mode.label: UI Mode
